snippet.title: Godly Wives and Biblical Marriage feat. Lissy Dillon and Rachel Mowrey
snippet.description:
What does it mean to be a godly wife, and how does that shape a marriage that honors Christ? In this episode of the Jubilee Church Podcast, host Jordan Dillon and his wife Lissy sit down with Lead Pastor Bryan Mowrey and his wife Rachel for an honest, biblical, and practical conversation about marriage. They share stories of what first drew them to one another and the role of community in choosing a spouse, reflect on the power of a wife’s words to either build up or tear down her husband, and wrestle with questions of ambition, direction, and decision-making in marriage. 
The conversation digs into what biblical submission really looks like (and what it isn’t) while also exploring how couples can balance home life, work, and kingdom priorities. Along the way, they discuss how to process shortcomings, navigate seasons of failure, and ultimately keep Christ at the center of their relationship. Whether you’re single, newly married, or years into marriage, this episode will encourage you to trust God’s design for marriage and to find hope in His goodness.

👉 Watch Bryan’s referenced sermon “Calling All Leaders” from the story of Deborah here: https://vimeo.com/353247792
